about.title: Pomona Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person was careless, the family is left to carry grief and paperwork at the same time. In Pomona, that reality reached households in 2025, a year the city recorded 16 traffic deaths alongside 1,003 injury collisions. Some of those crashes happened on the I-10 San Bernardino Freeway; others unfolded on surface streets such as Garey Avenue, Mission Boulevard, and Holt Avenue, where public records show the heaviest collision volume. A wrongful death claim in California is a civil case, entirely separate from any criminal charges the Los Angeles County District Attorney may or may not pursue. It allows a spouse, domestic partner, or child, and in certain situations other dependents or heirs, to seek compensation for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Pomona families with an independent attorney who handles these claims on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Pomona Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched for you
items.desc: A wrongful death action generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Early contact protects those deadlines.

items.title: Every recoverable loss is accounted for
items.desc: Funeral and burial expenses, the income your loved one would have earned, and the loss of their companionship and guidance are all part of a California claim. An independent attorney works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The CHP report for a crash on the I-10 in Pomona already faults the other driver. Do we still need a civil claim?
items.answer: Yes, if your family wants to recover losses. A collision report or even a criminal case is separate from a wrongful death action, which is a civil matter brought by the family. The report can be helpful evidence, but it does not by itself compensate anyone for funeral costs or lost support.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring a wrongful death case in California?
items.answer: The surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children come first. If there are none, certain other dependents or heirs may have standing. Because eligibility can get complicated with blended families or unmarried partners, it is worth having an attorney review your specific situation.

items.question: How long do we have to act after a death in Pomona?
items.answer: Generally two years from the date of death. If a government entity may be responsible, such as a claim involving a city vehicle or a public roadway, the deadline is much shorter and starts with an administrative claim. LawProactive can connect you with an attorney promptly so nothing is lost to timing.
